claim: The murine catecholamine methyltransferase mTOMT is essential for mechanotransduction by cochlear hair cells.
source: The murine catecholamine methyltransferase mTOMT is essential for mechanotransduction by cochlear hair cells
evidence: This is the main claim stated in the title of the manuscript, which would be supported by the experimental findings presented in the full manuscript.
The functional classification of mTOMT as a catecholamine methyltransferase is stated directly in the title.

claim: mTOMT is expressed in cochlear hair cells.
source: The murine catecholamine methyltransferase mTOMT is essential for mechanotransduction by cochlear hair cells
evidence: For mTOMT to be essential for mechanotransduction by cochlear hair cells, it must be present/expressed in these cells.
This is established scientific knowledge about the function of cochlear hair cells in converting mechanical stimuli to electrical signals.
